title: Why There's No Such Thing as a Good Billionaire
summary: Adam Conover argues that billionaire philanthropy is harmful, using examples like Patagonia's Yvon Chouinard. He says we should stop accepting the myths about benevolent billionaires.
why: HN uses it in threads about wealth and charity, either as support for the view that no billionaire is benevolent or as a contested counterpoint.

quote.text: I think this video about charities/funds as power-wielding vehicles bears some relevance
